questions.text: Will the S&P 500 close higher tomorrow than it closed today?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per the S&P 500 (SPX) official closing value reported by WSJ Markets, tomorrow's close > today's close.

questions.text: Will Central Park's high temperature tomorrow exceed the NWS forecast high issued today?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per the National Weather Service Central Park (KNYC) observed daily high vs. the NWS forecast high for that date issued the prior day, observed > forecast.

questions.text: Will the #1 movie at the U.S. box office tomorrow be the same title that was #1 today?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per Box Office Mojo's daily domestic chart, tomorrow's #1 title matches today's #1 title.

questions.text: Will the top story on the NYTimes.com homepage tomorrow morning be a different story than today's top story?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per a same-time (9:00 AM ET) comparison of the lead headline on nytimes.com, tomorrow's top story differs from today's.

questions.text: Will any MLB game scheduled for tomorrow go into extra innings?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per MLB.com's official scoreboard, at least one scheduled game tomorrow reaches the 10th inning or later.
